# A Short Curriculum

An index whose entries are not all written the same way. Thirty-six of the
thirty-eight below are list items and two are headings, which is the shape
real hand-maintained curricula drift into. A reader written for the majority
form reads thirty-six, emits thirty-six, and raises nothing.
